summary: Conduent filed an 8-K detailing an amendment and closing of its sale of the public transit and fare collection business (Conduent Transport Solutions and certain non-U.S. subsidiaries) to Modaxo for $164 million. The September 30, 2026 amendment made Modaxo France the sole buyer, deferred certain India assets to a subsequent closing pending regulatory approval, and waived some governmental filing conditions. The deal closed October 1, 2026, with Conduent receiving $140 million cash before a $10 million net-tangible-asset holdback, a $12 million special holdback, and $2 million of other adjustments. Watch the $12 million holdback release tied to customer target dates.
